title: Specified exchange from coherent coefficient comparisons
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B killed by the prime ell, the continuous-function condensed coefficient ring Lambda of B, any commutative square of separated finite-type k-schemes in the characteristic context of the restricted exchange API, and functors F_T from bounded-below etale B-module complexes to ambient internal Lambda-module complexes on every scheme T, assume coherent pullback and qcqs pushforward isomorphisms satisfying their mate unit and counit identities and the pullback-square coherence equation (CoefficientComparisonData). Then the specified restricted unit, square and counit factors on every bounded constructible realized complex admit a four-vertex comparison with the F-images of the corresponding etale factors; the comparison includes both specified total-arrow factorizations. This is the general formal transport step, with the geometric coefficient construction and underived essential image absent.

source.place: map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app and map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app; exchange component definitions

proof.text: The vertical maps are quasi-compact because their composites with the structure morphisms are the quasi-compact structure morphisms. They are separated because these composites are separated, hence quasi-separated. Identify the eta-expanded pullback projection family with the whole original family by reflexivity and transport P.square along that function equality while its CoefficientPullbackSquare predicate stays folded. Apply threeStepComparison_family to the actual etale functors and coefficientDerived functors, with the category families and instances fixed explicitly. The hypotheses are exactly P.unit, P.counit and the transported P.square; no derived construction is changed.

Prove equality of the whole internal diagrams: residueExchangeAdjunction equals coefficientDerivedAdjunction, and residueExchangeSquare equals coefficientAmbientSquare by the inverse composition, equality transport, and forward composition formulas. Rewrite the diagram argument by this equality, and reverse the four vertex isomorphisms by inverse cancellation in each of the three squares.

Use coefficientAmbientBoundedExchange_factorization for the source total and coefficientEtaleExchange_map_factorization for the target total. These are the original total maps by their defining equations. Work at arbitrary Lambda first and specialize to the continuous-function ring with the given torsion finiteness instance.
